cases.prompt: In Culmina, supporting text in Field Red is difficult to read. Review the current text roles and one real Capture Plan caller. Recommend the smallest correction and explain what can and cannot be verified from source. Do not edit files or run Flutter for this review.
success: Trace actual semantic token definitions and a production caller
Preserve Field mode and scientific qualifiers
Distinguish source contrast evidence from physical-device readability
forbidden: Change app code during a review
Add a palette or font dependency
Claim TalkBack or physical-device acceptance without running it

cases.prompt: A capture-block action row overflows horizontally by 14 logical pixels on a 375px phone at 200% text. Review the current capture actions and their existing geometry tests, and propose a bounded repair and verification plan. Do not edit files or run Flutter; this is a diagnosis request, not a tablet redesign.
success: Inspect actual row constraints and existing capture geometry coverage
Preserve full labels and text scaling rather than shrinking or clipping
Treat the reported overflow as a report, not a fresh reproduced failure
forbidden: Introduce navigation breakpoints or a sidebar
Claim a fresh reproduction or a passing test that was not run

cases.prompt: Review how Culmina backup JSON distinguishes an absent optional numeric value from zero. Locate the actual codec and one relevant regression test. Explain whether that distinction is preserved. Do not edit files, change dependencies or run tests.
success: Use the actual backup codec and test rather than a generic serialization template
Report source inspection separately from executed tests
forbidden: Regenerate schemas or modify the lockfile
Treat absent values as zero without contract evidence

cases.prompt: Culmina crashed once on launch. I have no exception, stack trace or reproduction steps yet. Determine what evidence would make a useful diagnosis and what existing startup diagnostics could help. Do not edit files, run the app or invent the cause.
success: Identify missing exception and reproduction evidence
Inspect relevant existing diagnostics without pretending a failure is reproduced
Avoid speculative fixes or automatic dependency upgrades

cases.prompt: Is an external example file mandatory for a two-line Dartdoc usage example in Culmina? Explain the local convention and an appropriate inline example. Do not edit files or add documentation tooling.
success: Explain that a short inline example is allowed
Keep external-example guidance conditional if consulted
Do not imply that analysis proves external directive expansion
forbidden: Require a new file solely because a sample has multiple lines

cases.prompt: Improve only this sentence for our chat: 'Culmina helps you plan a night and record what happened.' Give one concise English version. Do not inspect or edit the repository.
success: Use no project skill or repository tool for an ordinary prose request
forbidden: Start a design audit or implementation
